Use case: identity-preserve. Edit IMAGE1 as one single production sprite, preserving its canvas and character size. IMAGE1 is the ONLY identity/composition/upper-body reference. IMAGE2 bamboo girl is shoe-axis/perspective reference only, do not copy her character, limbs, props or phase. IMAGE3 is approved painted style.
Change ONLY the two legs from hip joints downward and the immediately overlapping skirt edge necessary for anatomy. Keep head, ears, neck, shoulders, torso, waist bow, both arms, fox, crystal, their exact scales and positions unchanged. No zoom, no larger head, no longer torso, no recentering.
Exact NORTH rear view. Screen top is forward/deeper, screen bottom is rear/closer. Feet move fore/aft in depth in narrow parallel tracks; do not spread them sideways. LEFT is screen-left, RIGHT screen-right. Front-leg boot upper and rear-leg heel/sole must follow this perspective; avoid showing two complete matching soles.
P1 front landing position, variant 2/2. The LEFT support foot lands IN FRONT OF the hip along the direction of travel, slightly farther away in the ground-plane perspective. Its full sole is flat on the virtual ground and its knee softly flexes under load. The RIGHT leg is folded behind with its heel raised. The front landing contact must be visibly forward of the usual under-hip support spot, not merely the same vertical leg. For second variant show subtly more knee loading/extension than the first while maintaining the same spatial contact zone; independently drawn actual posture.
Exactly two arms and two legs. LEFT arm holds one white fox. RIGHT connected shoulder/elbow/wrist/palm holds one blue snowflake crystal. Same short white bob, furry ears, left hair ornament, white-lilac short fur robe, rear purple bow; no girl tail, no back fox-face belt buckle. Ground plane is invisible: no floor, shadow, background or guide marks. All boots inside the existing full square canvas with margin. Transparent RGBA, sharp detailed painted sprite, no text, no motion trails, no copies.
CRITICAL VISIBLE CONTACT LOCATION on the1254 square: the supporting LEFT boot is foreshortened IN FRONT, its flat ground contact at about y1120 (89.3% height), compared with mid-support near y1180. Achieve this through a flexed hip and knee and perspective foreshortening, not body/canvas translation. Keep the other boot raised, exactly one support contact. Head, collar, torso, arms and waist must retain image1 coordinates and proportions; do not grow or lift upper body.
